Battle in the same car as you, in their colours
  1. Two runs: you chase, then you lead. The game steers; your throttle and angle set the gap.
  2. Chasing: keep the gap bar green (within a car length), same side, same angle.
  3. Leading: big angle and good speed.
  4. Each run is judged out of 100. Contact, spins and passing cost points; within 2%, it's one more time.
